prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one isolated modular 2D fantasy game face-and-hair sprite attachment, not a portrait card or full character.
Input image 1 is the edit target: a brown-haired boy head only. Edit only his hair into silver-gray short hair with a neat side part and short textured wisps. Keep the identical boy face, eye shape, warm reddish-brown iris color, eyebrow position, skin color, expression, cheek, ear, jawline, chin, three-quarter left-facing orientation, head scale, and placement. Preserve the current softly painted modern cartoon fantasy rendering and gentle dark outlines. Hair stays short inside approximately the existing head silhouette, with no long hair, ponytail, braid, rear hair sheet or additional accessories. Keep original padding and isolated head layout on the square canvas; chin connection remains at the same location. Do not add neck, shoulders, body, clothing, helmet, jewelry, lettering or decorative background. Actual transparent background with clean alpha, no shadow outside the head. Only change the hairstyle and hair color.
normalization: Technical alpha bounds crop using alpha >= 2 to ignore scattered generated alpha=1 pixels, Lanczos3 resampling to 61x51, and transparent padding back to original 96x96 canvas. No raster drawing, face compositing, or source overwriting.
limitations: Face and hair are combined in the original face.png attachment; this is one compatible replacement attachment, not a separate hair layer.
Identity is requested by image editing but is not pixel-identical; exact canvas, attachment size and bottom alpha anchor are preserved geometrically.
